jobs.description:

In this role, you will act as a technical leader at the interface of hardware development, supplier management, procurement, manufacturing, and technology strategy. You will identify emerging technologies, transform them into reusable hardware platform building blocks, and enable product teams worldwide to accelerate innovation through standardized and scalable solutions.
You will play a key role in shaping hardware platforms, driving technology roadmaps, and contributing to company-wide material and component strategies.

What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- A discounted public transport ticket so you're always mobile- Discounts on many products and services provided by the Siemens Corporate Benefits- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- The opportunity to take a sabbatical- Location-dependent childcare to help balance family and work

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.
You’ll make an impact by
Technology Scouting & Future Platform Management

- Monitor and evaluate emerging technologies, semiconductor trends, embedded computing platforms and electronic components.- Assess technical maturity, lifecycle risks, availability, cost competitiveness, reliability, and sustainability of new technologies.- Derive technology roadmaps and recommendations for future product platforms and align them with the needs of the HW product development.

Hardware Platform & Building Block Development

- Identify common hardware requirements across product lines.- Transform proven concepts into scalable reference designs and platform assets for worldwide reuse- Establish best practices for hardware reuse, modularization, and platform-based development.

Engineering Support & Technical Consulting- Act as a trusted technical advisor to global hardware development teams.- Support projects in selecting and integrating approved building blocks.- Provide guidance on component selection, architecture decisions, risk assessments, and technology adoption.

Material Strategy & Supplier Collaboration

- Represent R&D in global Material Strategy Teams - Contribute to company-wide component and semiconductor strategies.- Define preferred technology directions and approved platform components.

You excel in

- Education- Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Embedded Systems / Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.
- Experience & Skills- Minimum 8 years of experience in hardware development for industrial or automotive systems.- Proven experience in architecture development and hardware platform creation.- Strong understanding of component lifecycle management and semiconductor technologies.- Experience working with global development organizations and external suppliers.- Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions beyond project boundaries.
- Strong competence in Embedded hardware platforms, FPGA and programmable logic devices, EMC and signal integrity, Product lifecycle management
- Ways of working- Strategic technology mindset and strong analytical and systems-thinking capabilities- Strong analytical and systems-thinking capabilities- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills- Passion for innovation and platform engineering- Strong networking and collaboration skills- Self-driven and entrepreneurial working style
- Languages- Excellent German and English knowledge

jobs.occupation: Product & Solution Security Officer and CRA (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:

Acting as a 'Continuous Security Agent,' you will partner with the Agile Program Management Office (APMO) to bring state-of-the-art security innovations to our agile teams. You will build vibrant communities and guilds to promote a culture of continuous learning. As a trusted advisor, you will guide R&D and PLM leadership, collaborating closely with the SI GSW Cybersecurity Officer to provide functional guidance to our network of PSSEs.
What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- Appealing Siemens pension benefits- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard

jobs.occupation: Business Development and Key Account Manager (all genders) (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLEAt ERC, we are developing hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft for critical missions across uncrewed and crewed applications. Victor is our uncrewed heavy-lift cargo UAS for time-critical cargo, logistics, military resupply, and other critical dual-use missions. Charlie is our future crewed aircraft for passenger and patient transport, including air ambulance and interhospital transport.
In this role, you will identify and develop commercial opportunities and build long-term customer and partner relationships. Working closely with Commercial Leadership, Product, Engineering, and Flight Operations, you will turn customer needs into account strategies, go-to-market projects, partnership models, and concrete customer programs.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Identify, qualify, and strategically develop commercial opportunities across our priority customer segments, use cases, and target accounts
• Own selected key accounts from initial engagement through structured needs assessment, opportunity development, implementation projects, proposal generation, and long-term growth
• Drive customer and partner initiatives such as workshops, customer demonstrations, operational validation projects, and joint entry-into-service projects
• Coordinate externally facing projects across internal teams, keeping timelines, responsibilities, decisions, and stakeholder expectations under control
• Support the refinement of ERC’s commercial strategy by contributing customer and opportunity insights, market research, and competitor analysis
• Help translate customer and operator needs into mission concepts, product requirements, demonstration objectives, and commercially viable solutions in collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Flight Operations
• Support the planning and execution of product demonstrations, trade fairs, and industry events; and represent ERC in customer meetings, demonstrations, trade fairs, and industry events.

WHAT YOU BRING
• Approximately 2-3 years of experience in business development, key account management, sales, management consulting, or a comparable high-pace, high-performance environment
• Proven experience building sustainable relationships with customers, partners, or other external stakeholders in complex industry environments
• Strong project management skills and the ability to drive cross-functional workstreams with clear structure, ownership, and follow-through
• Strong analytical and commercial judgment, including the ability to prioritize customer needs and business opportunities
• Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills
• A structured, self-directed, and ownership-oriented working style in an entrepreneurial environment
• Fluency in English and willingness to travel.

Moreover, it would be helpful if you also
• have first experience in industries such as logistics, infrastructure, offshore operations, aviation operations, or adjacent markets
• bring aviation experience or strong technical curiosity for aircraft, UAS, eVTOL, autonomous systems, or complex tech products
• are familiar with military procurement processes, bring an active military network, or have formerly served in the armed forces
• speak German at C1 level or above.

WHAT WE OFFER
• Full-scale aerospace engineering, not concept slides
• A 60+ engineer team at Ottobrunn
• Real ownership and flat hierarchies: a modern startup culture where your input shapes decisions, not just execution
• Flexible working hours, remote work, and competitive compensation
• Health & wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass membership and subsidized lunch in our canteen
• Office extras: espresso coffee, fresh fruit, and soft drinks, plus regular team and company events, and plenty more once you're on board

ABOUT THE ROLEJoin ERC’s flight test team and contribute to the development and certification of next-generation unmanned aircraft systems. As a Flight Test Engineer, you will contribute directly to the development and certification of our uncrewed heavy-lift VTOL platform. You will be responsible for the planning, execution, and evaluation of ground and flight tests, ensuring safe and compliant operations while generating the data needed to advance our aircraft toward certification.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
• Plan, prepare, and coordinate aircraft ground and flight test campaigns for development and certification activities
• Act as focal point for test requests from engineering departments and translate them into structured ground and flight test plans
• Categorize test requests and define test objectives, test conditions, and instrumentation requirements in collaboration with relevant stakeholders
• Support the planning, installation, and documentation of flight test instrumentation
• Conduct pre-flight inspections and regular maintenance activities
• Support engineering teams in the manufacturing, integration, test aircraft
• Support weight and balance calculations and measurement activities
• Participate as remote crew member in ground and flight tests by managing and monitoring test sequence execution using telemetry systems from the ground station
• Conduct pre-test briefings and post-test debriefings
• Initiate, coordinate, and track actions to resolve deficiencies and implement recommendations identified during debriefings and in test reports
• Create and maintain comprehensive test documentation, including Flight Test Cards and Flight Test Reports
• Support the continuous development of our Flight Test Organization by improving tools, processes, and methodologies

WHAT YOU BRING
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace engineering or a comparable discipline
• Professional experience in flight test operations incl. test planning, execution, and data analysis with manned aircraft and/or rotorcraft, or professional experience in the operation of drones and/or model aircraft
• Solid understanding of aircraft systems, flight mechanics, and flight test methodologies
• Hands-on mindset with the ability to work effectively in a dynamic flight test environment
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
• Ability to coordinate across multiple engineering disciplines
• Flexibility and willingness to travel and stay at national and international flight test locations for short- and mid-term campaigns
• Very good verbal and written communication skills in English and German

Nice to have:
• Experience with eVTOL or unmanned aircraft systems
• Knowledge of EASA certification frameworks (e.g., SC-VTOL, SORA)
• Experience with telemetry systems and flight test instrumentation
• Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., Python, MATLAB)

WHAT WEC OFFER

The portfolio includes Electron Microscopy (EM), X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), software, services and related analytical workflows. Using your technical knowledge and strong interpersonal skills, you will engage effectively with both prospective and existing customers. You will own the full sales cycle—from lead generation and opportunity development through negotiation and closure.

Education

- Previous client-facing commercial experience is required.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Business-fluent English is required.

- Strong interpersonal skills and an openness to working across cultures and diverse teams.

- Ability to develop and maintain strong internal and external customer relationships.

- Collaborate with various internal and external stakeholders

What you bring:

- Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science or Information Systems, with a research focus on large-scale agile development, engineering metrics, or communities of practice in software organizations

- Strong hands-on mindset and willingness to translate promising research direction into product functionality
- Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented mindset
- Good written and verbal communication skills in English, German is a plus

The Academic Partnership organization at SAP is the bridge connecting SAP and academia. We build collaborative, structured partnerships with academic institutions and encompass a wide range of activities and programs in regards of academic teaching, academic community management, and PhD talent management.

The PhD Graduate Team stands for embedding cutting-edge research into functional teams across SAP, bringing together interdisciplinary PhD talent in a research-like environment.

At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

The role

As a Lead Photographer in the HelloFresh Studio, you are part of our Photography team, working across food, product, lifestyle, and marketing productions. You are first and foremost an exceptional photographer with deep technical and visual expertise, setting the benchmark for photographic quality, craft, and production excellence across the Studio.

You lead through expertise, influence, and example, helping elevate the capabilities of the photography team while maintaining high standards across large-scale asset production. You play a key role in developing photographic talent, evolving ways of working, and driving continuous improvement.

You collaborate closely with Producers, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to deliver high-quality and scalable visual production across multiple brands. You stay up to date with industry developments and actively support AI direction, experimentation, and content generation initiatives within the Studio and broader organization, helping translate new technologies into practical production workflows.

What you’ll do

- Lead by exampleand continuously raise the bar for photographic quality and execution across the Studio
- Execute and oversee food, product, lifestyle, and marketing photography to the highest commercial standards
- Coach, mentor, and support photographersthrough feedback, knowledge sharing, and hands-on guidance to elevate overall team capability
- Define, maintain, and continuously improvephotographic standards, shooting guidelines, and best practices
- Work together with Studio leadership to improve production quality, studio efficiency, and scalable ways of working
- Collaborateclosely with Art Direction, Styling, Culinary, Post-production, and Creative teams to ensure strong and consistent visual execution
- Support complex productionsand solve creative and technical and production challenges on set
- Drive consistencyacross large asset volumes while maintaining visual excellence and operational efficiency
- Actively contribute to Studio and company AI initiativesby supporting experimentation, developing practical use cases, and helping integrate AI-supported and hybrid content creation workflows
- Act as a trusted expertand escalation point for photographic quality, technical decision-making, and production excellence

What you’ll bring

- You are a seasoned photography professional with 7+ years of experience in commercial photography, ideally including food, lifestyle, product, and high-volume e-commerce content production
- You demonstrate exceptional photography craft and technical excellence. Providing a portfolio is mandatory
- You have deep expertise in lighting, composition, camera systems, color, production environments, and visual storytelling
- You have experience operating in fast-paced production environments and collaborating across multiple disciplines and stakeholders
- You naturally elevate others through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and sharing best practices
- Experience leading photographers or creative production teams is a plus
- You are highly influential, collaborative, and comfortable aligning stakeholders without relying on hierarchy
- You have a strong production mindset and continuously look for opportunities to improve workflows, quality, and efficiency
- You stay current with developments in photography, visual production, and AI-supported content creation, and understand how to apply new technologies in a practical production environment
- You have expert knowledge of Capture One and strong understanding of color grading and image editing. Experience with additional photography, automation, or AI-supported production tools is a plus
- You can interpret and deconstruct creative briefs and translate them into practical photographic approaches, balancing creative intent, production realities, and visual quality
- You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English
